named_entities.name: Silicon Data LLM Token Expenditure Index

key_points: The Silicon Data LLM Token Expenditure Index, which doubled since its launch in Dec 2025, has fallen nearly 20% from its May 2026 peak.

Analysts warn this could curb expectations of explosive AI growth and pressure capital‑expenditure plans of major AI giants.
